	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.01)

			local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

				Character = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			end

			if not Character then
				continue
			end

			local VoidToggled = t1.value1.Void.VoidToggled or (t1.value1.Void.SpamToggled or t1.value1.Void.BaitToggled)

			if VoidToggled then

				t1.value20 = nil
			end

			if not t1.value20 then
				continue
			end

			local function v303(p75)
				local v304 = math.abs(p75)
				local v305 = math.min(v304, 1000000)

				return math.random(-v305, v305)
			end

			local YMax = t1.value1.Void.YMax

			if Active then
				Active = t1.value1.Void.VoidToggled
			end

			if Active then
				Character.CFrame = CFrame.new(t1.value20.X + v303(t1.value1.Void.X), t1.value20.Y + math.random(v308, v311), t1.value20.Z + v303(t1.value1.Void.Z))

				continue
			else

				if Spam then
					Spam = t1.value1.Void.SpamToggled
				end

						if v315 then
							v315 = t1.value1.Void.SpamToggled
						end

							break
						end

							Parent = Character.Parent

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
			t1.value43()
		end

		if gameProcessed then
			return
		end

		if input.KeyCode == t1.value1.Void.VoidKey then
			t1.value1.Void.VoidToggled = not t1.value1.Void.VoidToggled

			if t1.value1.Void.VoidToggled then
				local Void2 = t1.value1.Void
				local Void3 = t1.value1.Void

				Void2.SpamToggled = false
				Void3.BaitToggled = false
			end

			t1.value15("Void", t1.value1.Void.VoidToggled)
		end

		if input.KeyCode == t1.value1.Void.SpamKey then
			t1.value1.Void.SpamToggled = not t1.value1.Void.SpamToggled

			if t1.value1.Void.SpamToggled then
				local Void2 = t1.value1.Void
				local Void3 = t1.value1.Void

				Void2.VoidToggled = false
				Void3.BaitToggled = false
			end

			t1.value15("Void Spam", t1.value1.Void.SpamToggled)
		end

		if input.KeyCode ~= t1.value1.Void.BaitKey then
			return
		end

		t1.value1.Void.BaitToggled = not t1.value1.Void.BaitToggled

		if t1.value1.Void.BaitToggled then
			local Void2 = t1.value1.Void
			local Void3 = t1.value1.Void

			Void2.VoidToggled = false

		end

	end)
